initial: loading until document.fonts.ready, then transparent idle
replay: Last started payload; bypasses ID dedupe; still respects capacity; invalid before first start
cancel: Returns cancelled; clears queue; stops current; invalidates stale completion; retains IDs and last payload

animation.seek: window.AlertTimeline.seek(seconds); paused inspection only, not event completion

preview: Explicit ?preview=1 only; one synthetic event after fonts; controls; no auto-loop
transport: Not included; Stream Studio backend owns authorization and delivery
